Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause, (c) Vladimir Agafonkin, Cloudmade) and Supercluster 8.0.1 (ISC, (c) Mapbox).
Self-hosted so the app loads from one origin, works offline and passes a strict Content-Security-Policy.
MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 (BSD-3-Clause) and @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet 0.0.22 (ISC) draw the OpenFreeMap vector basemap inside the Leaflet map.
